It fits here because I did not run it to ground. I built the framework for the community to show the art of the possible. I want everyone to look for errors or frame up the potential we can accelerate the growth of research exponentially.

Cheers,

children.author: Mer-Waves
children.text: Interesting! open sourced health research is always an interesting topic because of who bares the costs incurred to generate the evidence and then, how do we balance evidence available to all for the greater good and those using this freely available evidence to then generate revenue with their own applications of it...
